direct_path.scope: opaque closed prisms only; touching boundaries blocks; no terrain/vegetation occlusion

density.definition: union footprint area / buffered horizontal path area

cross_section_free_width.definition: free interval through midpoint on perpendicular cut; capped at 2*radius; not surveyed street width

building_environment.scope: loaded footprints only; 2D statistics ignore height/material; boundary clipping and missing buildings can bias them

total_level.source: 10*log10(sum(10**(Li/10))); uncorrelated receiver contributions; matching band/Z/20uPa/time interval required

noise.scope: environmental pressure noise only; excludes unknown microphone/electronic self-noise; do not double count measured weather

estimated_received_level.source: reference source SPL minus explicit model losses; no measured signal

signal_noise_difference.source: estimated band signal SPL minus combined environmental noise; not detector SNR

source.source: 原文未给方位测角精度及统计定义

azimuth_scale.reason: base + noise penalty + multipath proxy penalty + screening penalty; not RMSE, confidence interval or actual direction estimate

azimuth_transverse_scale.source: range*tan(angular scale); illustrative displacement only, not position accuracy

source.source: 原文未给俯仰测角精度及统计定义

elevation_scale.reason: base + noise penalty + multipath proxy penalty + screening penalty; not RMSE, confidence interval or actual direction estimate

elevation_transverse_scale.source: range*tan(angular scale); illustrative displacement only, not position accuracy

range_error.source: no time-of-flight, source-power calibration or ranging estimator

estimated_target_position.source: known input coordinates are not an acoustic localization result

estimated_effective_range.source: single link quality cannot infer a site-wide detection boundary

result.scope: stationary single-band point-source approximation; unknown direct-path height stays unknown; blocked path can retain finite sound; no waveform, beamforming, refraction, coherent reflection, trajectory or deployment optimization
